Sebastian Muller is a rock-solid data engineer who consistently delivers under pressure. As a daily collaborator, I’ve watched him own critical systems without micromanagement.  

Sebastian’s AWS expertise shines in scaling game analytics pipelines. He rearchitected our data lakes to handle 10x traffic spikes without downtime, and his cost-optimization tweaks saved the team $20k/month. He also built a Kafka-based real-time dashboard that cut query latency by 40% for live player metrics. His Airflow workflows are bulletproof—once he debugged a legacy ETL job, it ran flawlessly for 90+ days with zero manual intervention.  

What sets him apart is his Python craftsmanship. He refactored our data warehouse schema to support new game features, and his mentorship helped junior engineers write cleaner, more scalable code. He’s the go-to for Snowflake quirks, and his Terraform modules have made our infrastructure deployments 50% faster.  

Sebastian’s work ethic is unmatched. He’ll stay late to fix a broken pipeline or iterate on a tool until it’s perfect. If you need someone who’ll own a problem and make it go away, look no further.
